ops.title: Delete the three BundleDigest hand-copies against daemonkit v0.21.4
ops.description: daemonkit v0.21.4 exports deploy.BundleDigest (deploy/generation.go:139, byte-identical to the private original, drift-pinned by TestBundleDigestPinsOneExactTree). Three consumers carry TODO'd verbatim copies that now delete mechanically, each in its next routine ship (bump daemonkit pin to v0.21.4 in the same commit): fusekit holder/plan.go:715 (on main as of v1.16.0), captain-hook internal/hookd/deployment.go:448, cc-notes internal/helperdeployment/deployment.go:230 (shipped with the v0.21 migration).

ops.text: zero hand-copies of the bundle-tree digest remain fleet-wide (grep for the TODO string returns nothing in fusekit, captain-hook, cc-notes)
each of the three repos builds green against deploy.BundleDigest with daemonkit pinned >= v0.21.4
